description: A battery-backed real-time clock module with an I2C interface.
how_to_use: Wire SDA/SCL to the board's real I2C pins; multiple I2C devices can share the same SDA/SCL lines.

plain.what: A clock that keeps the time and date, even when the Arduino is off (thanks to its coin battery).
plain.how: VCC and GND for power, SDA and SCL to the Arduino's matching pins. Set the time once, then read it any time.
